title: erysimum cheiranthoides f. paniculatum
intro: Erysimum cheiranthoides f. paniculatum, commonly known as the wallflower, is a flowering plant in the Brassicaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which have been used to support health and well-being. The health benefits of wallflower include its ability to act as an expectorant, helping to relieve respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. The bioactive constituents of wallflower include isothiocyanates, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties.
